name: Phoenix Wings (Combat, Style)
body:
Your fire aura lifts you in the air.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 17, Phoenix Burn, Phoenix Style, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +13 or monk level 9th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. When you use Phoenix Style, you can fly as per the wind jump unchained monk ki power. If you already have the wind jump power, your fly speed doubles.
